messages:
maria: Quick sync — follow-ups from last night's limited deploy that caused a 95th-pct latency spike. Proposals: 1) auto-rollback on latency regressions; 2) default small blast radius for new flags; 3) explicit canary metric gating + thresholds; 4) incident recurrence analysis and quarterly checklist. Need owners + timelines.

alex: +1. I've added a high-level epic to the platform board. Can we get a PR for auto-rollback scaffolding by EOD Wed?

tasha: I can take flag scoping. Proposal: default audience cap = 1%, server-side enforced. Will draft config and tests.

samir: I can own canary gating. Plan: add metric gating job that watches 1,5,95 latency + error rate; abort rollout if 95th > baseline * 1.25 for 5m. Will prototype.

kevin: For rollback mechanics: prefer two-step approach: soft rollback (route traffic off new instance, preserve shape) then hard rollback (revert code/model). Soft rollback should be automatic and non-disruptive.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-11-15T02:12:01Z started for release/feat/limited-deploy

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-78 created (latency spike during staged roll). Pager duty notified.

tasha: sample flag config I'm proposing:
```json
{
  \"flag\": \"new-search-index\",
  \"default_audience_pct\": 1,
  \"max_active_users\": 1000,
  \"scoped_environments\": [\"staging\",\"canary\"],
  \"enforcement\": \"server\"
}
```

samir: canary gating pseudo-rule:
```
if (p95_now > baseline_p95 * 1.25 && p95_window >= 5m) then abort_rollout()
if (error_rate > baseline_error * 1.1) then abort_rollout()
```
I'll add this as a pipeline check in the rollout controller.

alex: timeline check: can we have a minimum viable auto-rollback (alert + soft rollback) in 2 sprints? Owners: samir (gating), infra/kevin (rollback plumbing), tasha (flag caps). I'll set up weekly sync.

maria: Owners and deadlines tentative:
- Auto-rollback MVP: samir + kevin — target 2026-11-30
- Flag default scoping + tests: tasha — target 2026-11-24
- Postmortem recurrence analysis + checklist: maria — target 2026-11-27

kevin: I'll prepare a small demo PR with rollback API and a smoke test. Example command to simulate:
```bash
rcli rollout simulate --id tmp-123 --latency 1.3x
```

samir: I'll wire up metric alerts and add a canary dashboard. Will post PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1102

tasha: I'll add unit tests and a migration to cap existing flags.

maria: Cool. Weekly sync scheduled Thu 10am. Please update the epic with the PR links and set assignees. If anyone hits a blocker ping me or @alex. Thanks :thumbsup:

alex: noted. tagging @eng-oncall for visibility.

oncall-bot: Reminder: next oncall rotation starts 2026-11-20.

kevin: one quick question — do we want a kill-switch env var for emergency? I propose `ROLLBACK_DISABLE=false` default.

maria: Good call. Add as action: env-level kill-switch + RBAC on who can flip it. Assign to infra.

samir: I'll draft the canary gating RFC this week and post link in thread.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up in PM with assigned Jira tasks and the sync invite.
